title: Just stopped working after 8 months, but hardly used it
text: Just stopped working after 8 months, but hardly used it. Well it was good while it worked, I can't complain about any of it's features.  Today I filled it up and left the room, and when I came back it not only did not heat any water, but all of the water I had filled it with (not overfilled at all, I am certain) all of the water had dripped out of it and was all over the place.  ugh.  I had the unit since October, and it is now June.  I honestly did not use it often.  In light of all this, I would not recommend and would hope the seller/manufacturer reaches out to me.
